role: State clearinghouse agency / draft EIS commenter
stance_basis: letter explicitly states no effect on environment relative to aeronautical users
summary: The Department of Aeronautics reviewed the draft environmental statement for the Lincoln Highway improvement project and concluded that the proposed development would have no effect on the environment relative to aeronautical users. The agency's position appears twice in the document: once as a paraphrase in the comment-summary table and once as the full letter in Appendix A. In both instances, the department expresses neither support nor opposition, simply noting the project falls outside its area of concern.
complaint_summary: The Department of Aeronautics is listed among State Clearinghouse agencies that concurred, stating the proposed development will not have any effect upon the environment relative to aeronautical users.
summary_quote: It is the opinion of this office that the proposed development will not have any effect upon the environment relative to aeronautical users.
